boost_messages.title: Metaboost
boost_messages.description: To enable boost messages for your content, add the podcast:metaBoost RSS tag to your feed inside your podcast:value block. This tag tells apps where to send optional listener messages. Without it, listeners can still send payments but cannot attach a message.
boost_messages.page_intro: Metaboost is open-source software and an open standard for hosting listener messages alongside podcast value-for-value boosts.
boost_messages.page_signup: If a podcast wants their listeners to be able to attach messages to boosts in {brand_name}, they can sign up with any open-source Metaboost server (<link>metaboost.cc</link> is one option, and it is maintained by {brand_name}).
boost_messages.page_rss_tag: Metaboost gives the podcaster a simple <rssTag>podcast:metaBoost</rssTag> tag that they can add to their RSS feed, which will allow them to begin receiving boost messages.
boost_messages.page_open_standard: Since Metaboost is an open standard, any app that adopts the standard (not just {brand_name}), can send messages to the podcaster's Metaboost endpoint.

keyboard.intro: These shortcuts work across the site when focus is not inside a text field, search box, or other editable control.
keyboard.shortcut_play_pause_detail: Press Space to play or pause the current episode or track when the player has media loaded. Space is ignored while focus is in an input, textarea, select, or contenteditable field, and does not toggle play when focus is on a button or link (or inside a menu).
keyboard.shortcut_seek_detail: Press the Left or Right arrow key once to jump 10 seconds. Repeating the key does not seek again until you release it (no key repeat).
keyboard.shortcut_volume_label: Volume (when the volume slider is focused)
keyboard.shortcut_volume_detail: With keyboard focus on the player volume slider, Left and Right arrow keys decrease or increase volume by 5% per press.

terms.service_intro: {brand_name} is operated by {legal_name}. These terms describe how we handle your data and our service.
terms.never_sell_data: {brand_name} will never sell or share private user data.
terms.no_ads_without_permission: We will never put advertisements next to or within a podcast's content without that podcast's permission.
terms.audio_video_hosting: All audio or video files found on {brand_domain} load from the podcaster's own public server. We do not host podcast audio or video files ourselves.
terms.third_party_feeds: We host podcast links and content from third-party podcast feeds and sites. These have their own independent privacy policies, and we have no responsibility for their content or activities.
terms.clips_crowdsourced: All clips hosted on {brand_domain} are crowd-sourced and unofficial, unless otherwise noted by the podcaster themselves.
terms.clips_load_full_episode: Clips load within the full episode's media file, so the user always has access to the full recording.
terms.reduced_size_images: We also host reduced size podcast images from podcasters' feeds, to save user network data and speed up page loading times.
terms.data_service_necessary: Queue, sign-in, and account playback data are required to run {brand_name}. We do not ask for separate consent for this core functionality. Remembering playback while logged out is optional and controlled by the cookie banner.
terms.data_listen_stats_body: {legal_name} may record pseudonymous listen events to show trending content. Events are kept for {retention_days} days. You can opt in or out in account settings.
terms.data_listen_stats_anonymization: Statistics use an internal account identifier. It is not shown as your public profile or username.
terms.data_web_analytics: Anonymous web analytics (Cloudflare) load only if you accept analytics cookies in the consent banner.
terms.data_retention: Raw listen-stat events are deleted after {retention_days} days.
terms.data_requests: For access or deletion requests, email {contact_email}.
terms.cookie_choice_all_help: Analytics and remembering playback while logged out.
terms.cookie_choice_essential_help: Remember playback while logged out; no analytics.
terms.cookie_choice_none_help: No optional device cookies; sign-in and account playback still work.
